verdict.rationale: Render documents an official CLI for managing services, Postgres, and Key Value datastores from the terminal. It supports viewing logs for multiple resources, opening psql and redis-cli sessions, and validating Blueprints, and its non-interactive mode for scripts and CI/CD suits agent-driven workflows; a probe confirms the docs at /docs/cli. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI in AI-native/agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use the Render CLI to manage your Render services and datastores directly from your terminal
The CLI also supports [non-interactive use](#non-interactive-mode) in scripts and CI/CD.
The Render CLI can manage services, Render Postgres databases, and Render Key Value instances.
